# 3. Favorite Equation

@eq-fav is the inductor voltage equation which states that the voltage across an inductor is proportional to the rate of change of the current passing through it.

$$
V_{\rm L} = L \cdot \frac{dI_{\rm L}}{dt}
$${#eq-fav}

# 4. Flow Chart Practice

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-chart
%%| fig-cap: Chart to see if you need water today.
graph LR
    A{Are you dehydrated?} -->|No| B(Are you sure?)
    A --> |Yes| C[Drink Water]
    B --> |No| C[Drink Water]
    B --> |Yes| D(You need water anyways)
    D --> C
```
